tasks.title: Canonical integration baseline and branch recovery
tasks.objective: Create one canonical integration ref, prove its contents and CI, and make every later card resolve its baseline from a repository status manifest.
acceptance_summary: A fresh checkout can resolve the integration ref.
The status manifest points to an immutable SHA.
205 kernel tests and 26 host bridge tests pass, or updated exact counts are recorded with reasons.
No geometry file differs from the reviewed baseline unless explicitly explained.

tasks.title: Documentation authority and AI onboarding correction
tasks.objective: Make the accepted Envelope architecture, active blocker and session authority unambiguous without deleting historical evidence.
acceptance_summary: A new agent reading only README/AGENTS/start_here reaches the Envelope canon and current card.
No current document instructs a kernel agent to implement the new engine in legacy decal modules.
Status labels are machine-readable.

tasks.title: Portable building.002 reproduction and fixture extraction
tasks.objective: Create a portable serialized `AnalysisSnapshotV1 + DecalRequestV1` reproducer and a minimal Blender-side fixture or scene generator for the selected edges 2, 3 and 7.
acceptance_summary: Before C-R2C, the portable kernel fixture returns `REFERENCE_ARRANGEMENT_NON_MANIFOLD` at the same point-contact topology.
After C-R2C, the same immutable fixture reaches RawCoverage.
Fixture hash and source mesh fingerprint are stable.
deliverables: Minimal Blender fixture or deterministic scene generator.

tasks.title: Occurrence-aware arrangement contracts
tasks.objective: Introduce versioned contracts for geometric points, topological occurrences, directed boundary halfedges and point contacts without yet rewriting traversal.
acceptance_summary: One ArrangementPoint can own at least three distinct occurrences.
Two loops can share a point and remain distinct regions.
Every directed halfedge references exactly one start and end occurrence.
Serialization and canonical ordering are deterministic.
deliverables: Migration note for arrangement implementation agent.

tasks.title: Exact boundary rotation system and successor map
tasks.objective: Implement exact circular ray ordering and a deterministic face-successor map over boundary occurrences.
acceptance_summary: Every emitted boundary halfedge has exactly one successor and one predecessor.
Point-touch fixtures with degree 4/6 succeed without merging occurrences.
Successor map is invariant under input segment order, rigid rotation and retriangulation.
Ambiguous coincident sectors return a named exact outcome, not an arbitrary pairing.
deliverables: Counters for points, occurrences, incident rays and ambiguous sectors.

tasks.title: Face extraction, loops and containment without vertex probes
tasks.objective: Replace vertex-outdegree traversal and boundary-vertex containment probes with occurrence-based halfedge cycles, face adjacency and certified interior witnesses.
acceptance_summary: Every boundary halfedge occurrence is consumed exactly once.
No loop is open or repeated.
Point-only contact does not merge area components.
Holes are assigned correctly when a hole vertex touches another boundary point.
Exact total area is preserved.

tasks.title: Occurrence propagation, field gate and independent verification
tasks.role: Independent verifier plus host adapter author
tasks.objective: Validate the full C-R2C slice, propagate occurrence IDs to debug output, and close the `building.002` RawCoverage blocker without touching interactions.
acceptance_summary: `building.002`, selected physical edges 2/3/7: Patch 0 reaches `RAW_READY`.
`REFERENCE_ARRANGEMENT_NON_MANIFOLD` is absent for the point-contact case.
Exact area and contributor provenance match the accepted expectation.
Every halfedge occurrence is consumed once.
Broadphase equals exhaustive oracle.
Source mesh is unchanged.

tasks.title: Conditional atomic multiway interaction contract gate
tasks.objective: If and only if the C-R2C field gate exposes a multiway failure, define the atomic same-alpha contract or preserve a named unsupported outcome.
acceptance_summary: All participant permutations produce the same result or the same named unsupported outcome.
No new matter or gap is introduced.
RawCoverage union preservation is explicit.
deliverables: Accepted multiway ADR and fixtures, or a formal decision to remain unsupported.

tasks.title: Internal labeled coverage cell-complex IR
tasks.objective: Define an internal IR for arrangement points, occurrences, halfedges, faces, labels and provenance handles, with explicit Raw/Resolved/Ownership stage views.
acceptance_summary: Cell complex represents multiple occurrences at one point.
Faces carry domain/contributor labels.
Stage derivation cannot mutate predecessor records.
DTO projection is possible without recomputing geometry.

tasks.title: Single labeled RawCoverage overlay
tasks.objective: Build one labeled overlay from PatchDomain boundaries and all Envelope boundaries, classify faces once, and derive both silhouette and per-contributor regions.
acceptance_summary: Supported fixtures produce equal area, topology, provenance and semantic digest.
Point occurrences are preserved.
No separate exact arrangement is invoked per Envelope on the new path.
Telemetry reports one Raw overlay build.

tasks.title: RawCoverage DTO projection and oracle retirement gate
tasks.objective: Project the cell complex to versioned RawCoverage DTOs, prove equality, and remove public-DTO-to-PlanarRegion round-trips from the active path.
acceptance_summary: Complete record equality for unchanged schema fields.
Explicit versioned differences for new occurrence records.
No active N+1 path in normal evaluation.
Permanent fixture-only oracle remains callable.

tasks.title: ResolvedCoverage as a derived cell complex
tasks.objective: Apply approved equality loci and interaction labels to derive a ResolvedCoverageComplex while preserving Policy B semantics.
acceptance_summary: Before/at/after interaction fixtures are exact.
Resolved union equals RawCoverage in approved v1 cases.
Equality loci are explicit ownerless candidates.
No polygon DTO round-trip in active path.

tasks.title: StaticPatchProgram and EvaluationState contracts
tasks.objective: Define alpha-independent static program contracts and alpha-specific evaluation-state contracts with stable semantic identities.
acceptance_summary: Static identities do not change across alpha.
No EvaluationState fact appears in AnalysisSnapshot.
Serialization and validation are deterministic.
Old APIs have an explicit deprecation path.

tasks.title: Compiler/evaluator migration to static program plus alpha state
tasks.objective: Compile once per source revision/request/domain and evaluate arbitrary alpha values into independent states.
acceptance_summary: One compile serves at least 100 alpha queries.
Reference Raw/Resolved records match accepted output.
Static objects are immutable and not mutated by evaluation.
Parallel evaluations of two alpha values do not interfere.

tasks.title: Compile cache and host invalidation graph
tasks.objective: Re-enable static program caching and install dependency-aware invalidation with telemetry.
acceptance_summary: Changing only alpha performs zero analysis rebuilds and zero static recompiles.
Changing selection rebuilds only affected programs.
Changing mesh revision invalidates all dependent states.
No stale state is published after a newer request.

tasks.title: Certified configurable reflex profile quality
tasks.objective: Generalize hidden-support count from an exact request policy while separating semantic profile quality from render tessellation density.
acceptance_summary: Default fixtures are bit/record compatible.
Selected k changes monotonically with reflex excess and selected quality.
Before/at/after threshold cases are exact.
Semantic digest changes when quality changes and does not change with render density.

tasks.title: Dimension-aware ownership cell-complex contract
tasks.objective: Define ownership semantics for open 2-cells, 1D interfaces and 0D contacts/junctions, plus separate geometry/content/audit digests.
acceptance_summary: Totality is unambiguous on open 2D interior.
Ownerless interfaces do not violate the contract.
Point-only contacts remain separate occurrences.
Changing diagnostics/timings does not change semantic geometry digest.

tasks.title: Reference ownership partition solver
tasks.objective: Build exact ownership claims over 2-cells and explicit interfaces from source/FrontReading/arrival facts.
acceptance_summary: Silhouette geometry digest is unchanged.
Every open 2-cell has exactly one owner or the entire result is a named unsupported outcome.
Interfaces are ownerless where required.
Provenance is complete.

tasks.title: Station and UV semantic facts
tasks.objective: Attach source station, transverse coordinate and UV facts to ownership cells and occurrences without coordinate welding or provenance reconstruction.
acceptance_summary: Every owned output occurrence has complete station/UV facts or a named unsupported outcome.
Distinct occurrences at one coordinate may carry different UVs.
Storage reversal does not change semantic flow.
Silhouette digest remains unchanged.

tasks.title: Semantic coalescing on OwnershipComplex
tasks.objective: Create a semantic coalescing stage that reduces representation complexity without erasing silhouette, ownership, UV, station, provenance or event interfaces.
acceptance_summary: Geometry and semantic digests are unchanged.
Only representation complexity decreases.
Point-contact occurrences are not welded.
Coalescing is deterministic and idempotent.

tasks.title: Downstream tessellation and GeometryBatch
tasks.objective: Produce a deterministic GeometryBatch with occurrence-aware vertex keys and complete semantic provenance.
acceptance_summary: One correct GeometryBatch is produced for the reference corpus.
Silhouette/ownership/UV digests match input semantic arrangement.
Coincident occurrences remain distinct vertices where required.
Every batch element has traceable provenance.

tasks.title: Read-only GPU preview and transactional BMesh adapters
tasks.objective: Implement or migrate host adapters to read GeometryBatch, preserve occurrence keys, and guarantee transactional mesh updates.
acceptance_summary: GPU and BMesh consume the same batch digest.
Failure leaves source mesh unchanged.
Coincident distinct occurrences remain distinct where semantic.
No host geometry algorithm exists.

tasks.title: Planar cross-Patch lift coordinator
tasks.objective: Define and implement planar cross-Patch lift with shared semantic anchors and named ambiguous cases.
acceptance_summary: Shared seam occurrences agree in 3D where contract says shared.
Per-Patch ownership/UV identities remain distinct as needed.
No cracks in supported planar fixtures.
Ambiguous cases fail closed.

tasks.title: Runtime benchmark corpus and SLA harness
tasks.objective: Create deterministic cold/warm/drag benchmarks and report both 16.7 ms and 33.3 ms frame budgets until a product SLA is selected.
acceptance_summary: One command produces machine-readable and human-readable reports.
Reports are reproducible and include hardware/runtime metadata.
All target scales are represented.

tasks.title: Exact lazy deterministic event ledger
tasks.objective: Implement an exact incremental event ledger with lazy successor scheduling and backward checkpoint/replay, matching the reference evaluator.
acceptance_summary: Runtime state equals reference semantic records/digest around every event.
Same-alpha processing is permutation invariant.
Backward replay returns the same state.
No full static recompile on alpha drag.

tasks.title: Filtered topology predicates with exact fallback
tasks.objective: Implement certified binary64 filters for hot topology predicates with authoritative exact fallback and no float-derived semantic IDs.
acceptance_summary: Complete semantic equality to reference.
Every uncertain result uses exact fallback.
Fallback fraction and time are reported by predicate family.
No new named failure caused by float authority.

tasks.title: Exact-value, provenance and digest interning optimization
tasks.objective: If R0/R2 profiling proves these costs material, introduce internal exact/provenance handles while preserving public serialization and semantic equality.
acceptance_summary: Reference records and public digests are unchanged or explicitly versioned.
Measured target workload improves materially.
Memory and parse/normalization counts decrease.

tasks.title: Native hot paths, GPU drag overlay and target-scale gate
tasks.objective: Port only measured hot paths, preserve Python contracts/reference tests, and meet the selected p95/p99 drag SLA.
acceptance_summary: Native and Python reference results are semantically identical.
Wheel/extraction CI passes.
3000-edge/50-patch workload meets the product-selected SLA.
Event frames and backward drag are included.
No source mesh mutation on cancellation/failure.

tasks.title: Evaluator-neutral contract audit for curved surfaces
tasks.objective: Audit and minimally generalize evaluator boundaries without implementing a curved solver.
acceptance_summary: No public semantic entity requires a global planar coordinate unless scoped to the planar evaluator.
Planar fixtures remain unchanged.
Curved error/metric authority is explicit.
deliverables: Curved evaluator ADR and interface gate.

tasks.title: Developable surface evaluator by certified unfolding
tasks.objective: Implement a certified developable evaluator that unfolds, invokes the planar evaluator and lifts results through explicit chart transitions.
acceptance_summary: Intrinsic coverage/ownership matches unfolded planar result.
Chart boundaries preserve occurrences and UV interfaces.
Non-developable input fails closed.

tasks.title: General-surface arrival algorithm research spike
tasks.objective: Compare candidate methods and produce an accepted SurfaceArrivalComplex contract and implementation recommendation, not production geometry.
acceptance_summary: Recommendation is supported by reproducible fixtures and numbers.
Cut-locus/multi-arrival cases are represented explicitly.
No silent smoothing or rail-constrained front.

tasks.title: Explicit noise and near-planar metric policy
tasks.objective: Define explicit, versioned metric policies; never let a solver smooth or project silently.
acceptance_summary: Same input/policy is deterministic.
Different policies have different semantic identity.
Out-of-budget inputs fail closed.

tasks.title: General SurfaceEnvelopeEvaluator
tasks.objective: Implement multi-source intrinsic arrival for curve generators, vector/tangent transport, multi-arrival equality loci and cut-locus events under explicit error contracts.
acceptance_summary: Hemisphere, ribbon and noise fixtures satisfy accepted error/topology contracts.
Ownership is deterministic and no ID tie-break occurs.
Mesh refinement is stable within the error contract.
Target-scale runtime is measured separately.
